description: This file contains C source code implementing arbitrary precision big number addition functions, including both signed and unsigned addition and subtraction operations, for handling large integers used in cryptographic computations.

methods.name: int BN_add(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * b)
methods.description: Performs signed addition of two big numbers, handling different sign combinations and delegating to unsigned addition or subtraction as appropriate.

methods.name: int BN_uadd(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * b)
methods.description: Performs unsigned addition of two big numbers, storing the result in r.

methods.name: int BN_usub(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * b)
methods.description: Performs unsigned subtraction of b from a, assuming a >= b.

methods.name: int BN_sub(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * b)
methods.description: Performs signed subtraction of two big numbers, handling sign logic and delegating to unsigned subtraction or addition as appropriate.
